summary: Bound QA V3 by complete serialized evidence rows so dense parser fragments cannot exceed the request envelope even when raw source text meets its old cap.
decision_refs: S3 selected six pages and 44,425 source bytes across 312 immutable evidence rows
The execution failed local request-size preflight and created no provider call
The previous 24 KB source-text cap omitted IDs, file names, locators and JSON escaping
approval_evidence: The user approved continued implementation of the lightweight, local, bounded Reference framework and the controlled fixed-question rerun.
known_limitations: The 18 KB bound may omit lower-ranked fragments from a selected page; the bounded evidence loop may request another literal search when a specific fact is missing.
The separate local selection audit can include more source text than one model decision receives.
This transport fix does not establish answer correctness or general-project accuracy.
